Ravi (ENG-MGR): Quick Q 1: Can we set Ari's promotion effective 2026-05-01 and still get retro pay if packet lands next Tuesday?
Tara (People Ops): Short answer: maybe. Retro pay needs signed comp-change + packet by payroll cutoff (next Tue EOD PT). If late, level can still be backdated but pay will roll to next payroll.
Ravi (ENG-MGR): What exact items do you need to avoid back-and-forth?
Tara (People Ops): Required: manager rationale (3 bullets), 2 contribution links + 1-line context each, peer feedback excerpt, proposed comp (base+bonus%), PeopleSoft ID, requested effective date, manager sign-off. Use promo template in HR portal.
Owen (Payroll): Also include employee DOB and legal name as in PeopleSoft to prevent mismatches. For retro, we also need a signed comp-change form PDF.
Claire (Comp): If base > band max submit a comp-exception note and CC comp-approvals. Between midpoint and max, include justification in packet for calibration.
Ravi (ENG-MGR): Is there a preferred filename?
ops-bot: File naming: promo_<FIRSTNAME>_<LAST>_<MGR>_<date>.pdf. Drop in /HR/PromoPackets.
Ravi (ENG-MGR): Can managers tell the person before payroll confirms?
Tara (People Ops): You can do a private 1:1 heads-up. Please avoid team-wide or public posts until People Ops confirms HRIS entry and payroll timing.
Ravi (ENG-MGR): Any tips for manager rationale wording?
Tara (People Ops): Be concise: Impact (metric), Scope (cross-team), Leadership (mentorship/ops). Example: "Reduced inference latency 30% by redesigning batching; led rollout across infra and app teams; mentored 2 ICs."
Ravi (ENG-MGR): Thanks. Quick checklist copy/paste?
Tara (People Ops): ```
- Promo template PDF
- Manager rationale (3 bullets)
- 2 contributions (links + 1-line context)
- Peer feedback excerpt
- Proposed comp (base, bonus %)
- PeopleSoft ID + DOB + manager sign-off
- Comp-exception note if > band max
- Equity request separate via grants form
```
Ravi (ENG-MGR): submitting Tuesday. appreciate the clarity.
Tara (People Ops): Thanks 1 will review quickly when you drop it.
ops-bot: Reminder: Do not announce promotions publicly until People Ops confirms payroll sync.
